rules.name: Additive Engine Behavior
rules.description: Fundamental properties of Harmless's additive synthesis engine

rules.explanation: Since harmonics are generated mathematically rather than summed from oscillators, there is no phase interference between frequencies
rules.implication: Can use extreme filter settings without artifacts

rules.explanation: Filters don't introduce phase shift or resonance artifacts because harmonics are already separated
rules.implication: 48dB brickwall slope sounds clean, unlike analog equivalents

rules.explanation: More harmonics in mask = more CPU usage. Silent harmonics cost nothing
rules.implication: Sparse masks are more efficient than rich ones

rules.explanation: Each harmonic can be individually controlled in amplitude
rules.implication: Can create impossible waveforms that don't exist in nature

rules.name: Harmonic Mask Rules
rules.description: Guidelines for drawing effective harmonic masks

rules.explanation: Harmonic 1 (fundamental) must be present for pitched sound
rules.guideline: Keep H1 at 100% unless creating special effects

rules.explanation: Odd harmonics (1,3,5...) create hollow/woodwind character. Even harmonics (2,4,6...) add warmth
rules.guideline: For clarinet/square: emphasize odds. For warmth: add evens

rules.explanation: Fast decay (1/n²) = dull. Slow decay (1/n) = bright. No decay = harsh
Leaving gaps between harmonics creates unique textures
rules.guideline: Try drawing only H1, H4, H8, H16 for metallic character

rules.explanation: Boosting specific harmonic bands creates vowel-like resonances

rules.name: Pluck Filter Rules
rules.description: How the Pluck filter simulates string physics

rules.explanation: Pluck filter removes high harmonics exponentially based on frequency
Pluck needs harmonics to decay - pure sine shows no effect
rules.guideline: Use sawtooth or rich masks with pluck

rules.explanation: For true plucks, set amp sustain to 0% so pluck decay is audible
rules.guideline: Sustain > 0% = pluck on sustained tone. Sustain = 0% = true decay

rules.explanation: Higher notes decay faster than low notes with same pluck setting
rules.guideline: Adjust pluck per octave for consistent character

rules.explanation: Phaser shifts each harmonic's frequency, not phase like traditional phasers
rules.effect: Can create pitch artifacts and inharmonic intervals

rules.explanation: Above 20Hz, modulation creates sidebands that sound like pitch shifting
Phaser recalculates all 512 harmonics every cycle
Each unison voice has independent phaser position
rules.effect: Massive stereo width when both active

rules.explanation: Detune percentage controls spacing between stacked voices
Stereo percentage pans unison voices across field
Multiple voices = louder signal. Blend reduces output
Harmless unison is optimized and doesn't cost much CPU
